'''Acan''' was a blond-haired [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a courier. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], he was sent by [[Nirama]] to [[Hedrett]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], to give a message to the [[Heroes of Cularin]]. He was killed shortly afterwards by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] thugs, [[Grug]] and [[Gurg]].
